This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin and slightly elongated snouts. One member of this species was present at [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]'s [[Grappa's palace|palace]]<ref name="Crimson Empire" /> in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="SWTCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gamorrean Guard Concept2.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Gamorrean Guard concept art by Ralph McQuarrie that would eventually become this species.]]
This species was first designed by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as a potential design for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean Guards]], though they would go unused,<ref name="RotJ AVA">''[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi: A Visual Archive]]''</ref> later reused for [[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 3|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 3]], illustrated by [[Paul Gulacy]]<ref name="Crimson Empire" /> and published on [[January 13]], [[1999]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54047/star_wars_crimson_empire_ii_-_council_of_blood_1998_3|text=Star Wars: Crimson Empire II - Council of Blood (1998) #3}}</ref>
